rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for courage or nerve, especially in phrases like having the guts to do something.

example.english: You really have the guts to go into that haunted house alone.
example.traditional: 你真係有膽，敢一個人去闖嗰間鬼屋。
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 jau5 daam2 gam2 jat1 go3 jan4 heoi3 cam3 go2 gaan1 gwai2 uk1
